title: trace-set/1: the XICs of a list of m/z, `mzlab-cli trace xic --mz M1,M2,...` or `--sweep LO:HI:STEP`
description: `--sweep LO:HI:STEP` gives exactly the bytes of `--mz` with the same centres as a list. One trace/1 document per ion, in the order of --mz, all of one file and sample, so each member is byte for byte the document `trace xic` gives for that ion alone. The CSV form (`--format csv`) is wide: the header is rt_min followed by one xic:<mz> column per ion, over the scans the ions share. Code: crates/mzlab-cli/src/trace_xic.rs.

sample.description: Sample id of a multi-sample file (.wiff); null for an mzML.

traces.description: A trace/1 per ion; evidence names its tolerance (tolerance_da, tolerance_ppm) and, with --smooth, the filter (smooth: 3 or 5); a member with no signal says empty: true and why (empty_reason).
